description: This file defines interfaces related to stream namespace predicates used for filtering implicit subscriptions within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes the IStreamNamespacePredicate interface for defining match logic and IStreamNamespacePredicateProvider for creating predicate instances from pattern strings.

classes.name: IStreamNamespacePredicate
classes.description: Interface for predicates that determine whether a given stream namespace matches certain criteria, typically used for filtering implicit subscriptions.

classes.name: IStreamNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Interface for providers that create IStreamNamespacePredicate instances from pattern strings, enabling deserialization and recreation of predicates.

methods.name: IStreamNamespacePredicate.IsMatch
methods.description: Determines if the consumer grain should subscribe to the specified stream namespace.

methods.name: IStreamNamespacePredicate.PredicatePattern
methods.description: Gets a string pattern representing the predicate, used for recreation of the predicate instance.

methods.name: IStreamNamespacePredicateProvider.TryGetPredicate
methods.description: Attempts to create an IStreamNamespacePredicate instance from a pattern string; returns false if not possible.
